Choose what to buildEach output is made by the same engine as the Krusgraph tools in Claude, from the keys and links you reviewed. Preview shows a dry run of each; nothing is created until you choose Create. Nothing is run, scheduled or published unless you tick it.
A notebook that writes a clean copy of each table: one row per key, every link checked, broken rows set aside.
PermissionsNeeds the delegated permission Notebook.ReadWrite.All or Item.ReadWrite.All.
A notebook that creates one wide view per fact table over the silver tables, with the keys and links as rules.
A pipeline that runs the silver notebook, then the gold views, then a check. It is not run or scheduled.
A Power BI semantic model (Direct Lake) with the keys, links and suggested measures.
A one-page report drawn from the semantic model's own measures and columns.
An API for GraphQL over the tables, with the links as relationships.
PermissionsNeeds the delegated permission GraphQLApi.ReadWrite.All or Item.ReadWrite.All.
A Fabric IQ ontology (preview): entity types with their keys and the links between them.
A data agent with the plan as its instructions and example questions, left unpublished as a draft.
A Fabric App (preview) over a read-only connector with every link: the key figures, list pages and charts you tick go into its package.Builder: Create makes an empty App item; the one step left is to run the package's command (shown after Create), and the app opens inside Fabric only, never from its link outside Fabric.
One name over what this build makes, with the domains Krusgraph proposes for these tables and an owner you choose later. It is kept in this item; Fabric domains themselves need a Fabric administrator.
